apps.name: Nightshift
apps.subtitle: Client for a self-hosted Nightshift server
apps.localizedDescription:
A native client for a self-hosted Nightshift server. Paste a Spotify, SoundCloud or YouTube link and watch the download live, search the iTunes catalog and pull tracks or whole albums straight into your library, manage the playlists the nightly job keeps in sync, and run that job by hand when you do not want to wait for the night.

Needs a Nightshift server (1.3 or newer recommended) reachable from the phone — on the local network or through a VPN.

versions.localizedDescription:
A finished run no longer claims an error it did not have: the closing statistic "Playlists failed: 0" carries the word the error rule looks for, and was counted as one.

The console header and the cookie warnings are translated. They had no entry in the German file, and a missing entry shows the English key instead of failing, so they read as English inside an otherwise German app.

The log now starts folded away, with a one-line summary in its place: how far the run got, and how many errors and misses it saw. Open it when you want the detail.

A banner on the downloads page warns when the server's YouTube or SoundCloud cookies have signed out, instead of letting the next nightly run discover it.

Tracks the catalogue does not have are no longer counted as errors.
